## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      4 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 13 авг. 2026 г. - 25 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _𓂙_, 24 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "I use this app because it offered the most for what you get now you have to pay a premium which you didn’t have to before just to use a barcode scanner I’ll be spreading the word via instagram and face book about this issue I’m sick and tired of being nickeled and dime for every little thing I won’t stand for my health to go through the same thing"
            2. _Leemiz_, 22 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Every three clicks on the app prompts it asking me to buy premium. No. I don’t want it and clicking so all the time is very very annoying"
            3. _Foody tracker_, 15 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Had this app for ages. Everything worked great then all off a sudden everything was behind a paywall and to scan my food I had to pay for the premium after using the app for years before."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      6 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 18 июн. 2026 г. - 26 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _plek keket_, 24 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "I’ve used this App for almost 10 years. It was the bread and butter of my weight training and healthy diet goals. They completely changed the user interface and now (for me at least) it’s basically unusable. It’s pretty disappointing, all the information that was helpful and intuitive and easy to compare (and then make decisions) is now scattered throughout the app. At least you get cartoon reminders of your streak! lol. Eating healthy is difficult enough but this app had always made it a little easier. Now logging food and comparing macros and calories is like running in mud. In my opinion you’re better off finding something else or go to pen and paper."
            2. _Verczeska_, 24 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "I have been a user since early 2010s. I loved it and I recommended it to all friends, family and clients. The new update made it all unusable, I find it hard to see what I actually consumed. Bring the old version back."
            3. _Jen,seeking resolution_, 17 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Terrible navigation, continually have Mondays entries end up on the following Sunday, no longer is there mass delete, various editing functions gone, way more clicks to add and delete, hideous UI and UX, glitchy. Did anyone bother to even do a feature gap analysis before deploying this junk that has had nothing but terrible reviews none of which have they remedied or even addressed? Boycot these people"
<!--/ir-theme-->
